components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The main action, Talk to Us.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #005F56; color: #FAF9F4; height: 56px; padding: 0 28px; border: 0; border-radius: 9999px; font: 600 1rem/1 Sora, system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 6px 16px -8px rgb(0 68 61 / 0.7); transition: background-color .2s, transform .2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #00443D; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(.97); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #FF6B00; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Pop Button
components.description: Orange variant for a second, louder placement of the main action.
components.css: .ds-btn-pop { background: #FF6B00; color: #2B2B2B; height: 56px; padding: 0 28px; border: 0; border-radius: 9999px; font: 600 1rem/1 Sora, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color .2s, transform .2s; } .ds-btn-pop:hover { background: #ff7f22; } .ds-btn-pop:active { transform: scale(.97); } .ds-btn-pop:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #2B2B2B; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Size Chips
components.description: Real-size selector with a yellow active pill.
components.css: .ds-chips { display: inline-grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 4px; padding: 4px; background: #005F56; border-radius: 9999px; } .ds-chips button { min-height: 44px; min-width: 72px; border: 0; border-radius: 9999px; background: transparent; color: #FAF9F4; font: 700 .875rem Sora, sans-serif; } .ds-chips button.on { background: #F7C600; color: #2B2B2B; } .ds-chips button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #FF6B00; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 8px; font: 500 .875rem Sora, sans-serif; color: #2B2B2B; } .ds-field input { height: 52px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid rgb(43 43 43 / .2); border-radius: 16px; background: #FAF9F4; font: 400 1rem Sora, sans-serif; color: #2B2B2B; } .ds-field input::placeholder { color: #77766f; } .ds-field input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #005F56; box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgb(0 95 86 / .15); }

components.name: Navigation
components.description: Top bar: wordmark, four links, one action.
components.html: DekhKhaoDemoHow It WorksFAQTalk to Us
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 24px; padding: 12px 24px; background: #FAF9F4; font: 500 .92rem Sora, sans-serif; } .ds-nav b { color: #005F56; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -.03em; margin-right: auto; } .ds-nav a { color: rgb(43 43 43 / .8); text-decoration: underline 2px transparent; text-underline-offset: 6px; } .ds-nav a:hover { color: #005F56; text-decoration-color: #FF6B00; } .ds-nav .cta { background: #005F56; color: #FAF9F4; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 10px 20px; font-weight: 600; }

narrative.northStar: The brand sticker sheet, come to life
narrative.overview: A cream page where food snaps onto the table at real size the way the cut-paper pieces of the Urdu mark snap together. Flat colour, bold Sora, one handwritten aside per heading, and a small family of geometric stickers used with intent.
keyCharacteristics: Geometric Urdu mark leads the identity
Real size shown with real numbers

rules.name: One field at a time
rules.body: A section is cream or teal, never both, except the managed-service split.

rules.name: Accents are stickers
rules.body: Orange, yellow and pink appear as shapes, strokes and chips, never as washes or small text.

rules.name: No labels above headings
rules.body: No eyebrows or section numbers; the headline speaks for itself.

dos: Show real size with real numbers
donts: No pink larger than a dot
Never present DekhKhao as ordering, POS or a digital menu
